summary: The patch adds mergedBy to GitHubPullRequestV1 and parses the REST merged_by user object into it, with optional/null handling and tests for read, list, unavailable and malformed actors. Human-merge provenance now receives the actor from live wire reads; no actionable defect was found.

evidence: src/contracts/ports-github-requests.ts:66-67 adds mergedBy?: string | null to GitHubPullRequestV1.
src/github/wire.ts:201-203 and 239 validate obj.merged_by with expectLogin and return mergedBy from parsePullWire.
tests/github/pull-merge-actor_test.ts:24-58 covers read and list preservation, null when unavailable, and fail-closed malformed actors.
tests/repair/human-merge-completion_test.ts:86-104 reads a wire payload with merged_by and proves human-merge provenance records the actor.
